name: Sapporo Snow Festival
description: Japan's most famous winter festival featuring massive snow and ice sculptures, illuminated displays, concerts, food stalls, and winter attractions.

name: Nagasaki Lantern Festival
description: Thousands of colorful lanterns illuminate Nagasaki's streets celebrating Chinese New Year traditions and cultural performances.

name: Takayama Spring Festival
description: One of Japan's most beautiful festivals featuring traditional floats, puppets, music performances, and historic streets.

name: Kamakura Festival
description: Historic festival known for horseback archery, traditional dances, tea ceremonies, and samurai culture.

name: Sanja Matsuri
description: One of Tokyo's largest festivals featuring portable shrines, parades, traditional costumes, and energetic celebrations.

name: Hakata Dontaku Festival
description: A massive festival attracting millions of visitors with parades, performances, and cultural showcases.

name: Atsuta Festival
description: Traditional shrine festival featuring fireworks, lanterns, dance performances, and Japanese cultural activities.

name: Gion Matsuri
description: Kyoto's most famous festival dating back to 869, featuring giant decorated floats, parades, and traditional celebrations.

name: Tenjin Matsuri
description: One of Japan's top three festivals featuring river processions, fireworks, traditional boats, and cultural events.

name: Aomori Nebuta Festival
description: Famous for enormous illuminated warrior floats, traditional music, dancing, and spectacular night parades.

name: Awa Odori Festival
description: Japan's largest traditional dance festival where thousands of dancers perform through the city streets.

name: Sendai Tanabata Festival
description: A colorful star festival featuring giant streamers, decorations, cultural events, and local traditions.

name: Owara Kaze no Bon
description: A graceful festival featuring elegant dances, folk music, lantern-lit streets, and traditional costumes.

name: Kawagoe Festival
description: Historic float festival featuring Edo-period culture, decorated floats, and traditional performances.

name: Nagasaki Kunchi
description: Unique cultural festival blending Japanese and Chinese traditions with dragon dances and performances.

name: Fujiwara Autumn Festival
description: Autumn celebration featuring colorful foliage, temple ceremonies, traditional parades, and local culture.
